response.query: How can we design a brief, high-validity teacher survey (target completion time, recommended item count, response formats, attention checks) derived from interview and observation themes?
response.answer: Design a 10-item teacher survey with Likert scale responses and one attention check. Aim for completion in 10 minutes.

results.title: What is Qualitative Research? — updated 2026 | IxDF
results.content: ## Qualitative Research Methods You Can Use to Get Behind Your Users. In iterative processes such as user-centered design, you and your design team would use quantitative research to spot design problems, discover the reasons for these with qualitative research, make changes and then test your improved design on users again. * **Participants** – Select a number of test users carefully—typically around 5 for single sessions of usability testing, often more sessions are needed—but for other types of qualitative research such as contextual inquiry you might need 10 or 20 participants. * When to Use Which User-Experience Research Methods - Detailed framework for choosing between attitudinal vs behavioral and qualitative vs quantitative methods. * User Research – Methods and Best Practices Course - Hands-on experience in usability testing, contextual inquiries, and qualitative interviews User Research – Methods and Best Practices | IxDF. Make learning **as easy as watching Netflix**: Learn more about Qualitative Research by taking the online IxDF Course User Research – Methods and Best Practices.
